scripts.build: bun run build:asset && bun build src/index.ts --outdir=dist --target=bun --minify
scripts.build:asset: mkdir -p dist/widget/bar-chart dist/widget/line-chart dist/widget/scatterplot && cp src/widget/bar-chart/bar-chart-widget.html dist/widget/bar-chart/bar-chart-widget.html && cp src/widget/line-chart/line-chart-widget.html dist/widget/line-chart/line-chart-widget.html && cp src/widget/scatterplot/scatterplot-widget.html dist/widget/scatterplot/scatterplot-widget.html
